newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: RFM to issue up to 1.2 billion-peso shrs.
newsitem.headline: RFM to issue up to 1.2 billion-peso shrs.

text.p: Food and beverage firm RFM Corp said on Wednesday its board had approved the issuance of up to 1.2 billion pesos worth of convertible preferred shares.
The preferred shares will carry a dividend rate of 10 percent per year. One preferred share will be convertible to one common share, the company said.
It said the offer price of the common share will be the market price near the time of the offering.
The preferred shares will have a term of five years.
The company did not specify the exact time of the offering but it had earlier said it planned to undertake this by year-end.
The proceeds of the issue will be used to finance the company's expansion and diversification programme.
